email.subject: Quick fix for Harbor Works' website
email.body:
Hi Ravi,

I checked Harbor Works Auto Care's site. Two things are likely costing you calls: there's no click-to-call number, so anyone browsing on a phone has to copy and dial manually instead of tapping to call. And your hours aren't listed, so people can't tell if you're open before driving over - many will just call a competitor instead.

The site's images are also slowing load times, which doesn't help.

I fix issues like this for a flat fee. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough showing exactly what's costing you customers - no obligation.

Worth a quick call this week?

Alex
